Community Wi-Fi Deployment — unconnected.org

Product Lead, Technical Operations unconnected.org Mar 2024 – Dec 2024

Overview

Deployed and operated public Wi-Fi networks serving 600+ daily users across Kenya, Nigeria and Malawi: MikroTik and Ubiquiti site builds, performance monitoring, documentation, and sustainable handover models for community-run networks.

Skills Used

MikroTik Ubiquiti Wireless Networking Network Monitoring Community Infrastructure

The Challenge

Community spaces had no affordable internet. Any solution had to survive power cuts, work within tight hardware budgets, and keep running after the deployment team left — which meant documentation and local capacity were as important as the network design itself.

What I Did

Site design & deployment

Designed and deployed outdoor Wi-Fi zones on MikroTik and Ubiquiti gear: mast-mounted access points, spectrum-aware channel plans, and bandwidth management so schools and community users each get a fair share.

Operations & monitoring

Set up monitoring and performance baselines, handled L2 escalations, and wrote the runbooks local teams used for first-line troubleshooting.

Sustainable handover

Worked with community stakeholders on sustainable operating models — simple status dashboards, escalation paths and maintenance checklists — so networks stayed alive beyond the project.

Outcome

  • 600+ daily users across community sites in three countries
  • Networks running in Kenya, Nigeria and Malawi with local first-line support
  • Reusable deployment and documentation playbooks for future sites
